trophies.guide: This is the reward for everything else: it unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then stranger strands, activities, collectibles, and money last — and the platinum lands on its own. There is no separate task behind it, so the other 54 guides in this list are the guide to this one.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, from start to finish. It is the first mission of the game, so this is the first trophy most players earn. Nothing needs doing before it — just follow the mission through to its end.
trophies.missable_reason: Story mission — it only happens once, at the very start of the game.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies unlock as the main story advances, so keep playing story missions until the chapter closes. Before moving on to Chapter 2, check the Stage 1 list for any one-shot trophies tied to Chapter 1 moments.
trophies.missable_reason: Story chapter — once Chapter 1 is done you cannot replay its missions for this trophy.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. The chapter trophy unlocks when the last mission of the chapter ends. Play the story missions in order and mop up any chapter-tied moments, such as partner robberies, before the chapter closes.
trophies.missable_reason: Story chapter — once Chapter 2 is done you cannot replay its missions for this trophy.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Keep following the main story and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's end. Use the time inside the chapter to attempt the one-shot moments that need a partner or a wanted level, since those chances thin out later.
trophies.missable_reason: Story chapter — once Chapter 3 is done you cannot replay its missions for this trophy.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. This is the last numbered chapter, so the end of its final mission closes the chapter. Before the final mission, sweep the Stage 1 missable list one more time — anything tied to a story moment should be done by now.
trophies.missable_reason: Story chapter — once Chapter 4 is done you cannot replay its missions for this trophy.

trophies.guide: Play the final mission through to the end of the story. This is a gold trophy because it marks the end of the whole campaign. Do every missable story trophy first: once the credits roll, the story moments are behind you.
trophies.missable_reason: The final mission — it only happens once, at the end of the story.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.missable_reason: A named story mission — it only happens once, when the story reaches it.

trophies.missable_reason: A named story mission — it only happens once, when the story reaches it.

trophies.missable_reason: A named story mission — it only happens once, when the story reaches it.

trophies.missable_reason: A named story mission — it only happens once, when the story reaches it.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game's own checklist. That means finishing the story, the stranger strands, the activities, the challenges and the collectibles — everything this guide tracks. Treat it as the last gold before the platinum: when the checklist in this guide is done, this one should be close behind.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: PlayStation official trophy description
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunts are jumps, near-misses, airtime and other driving feats, and they add up over normal play — but 250 is a grind, so chase them deliberately: look for jumps and ramps while travelling instead of fast-travelling everywhere. The count is tracked by PlayStation, so any stunt you pull counts toward the 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: PlayStation official trophy description
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type in the game at least once. PlayStation tracks 9 activity types, so sample them all: races, the shooting range, fishing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, drone races and the rest. You do not need to win or master any of them — one try of each type is enough.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: PlayStation official trophy description
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge. PlayStation tracks 42 challenges, so this is the long grind of the activity set: work through the range weapon by weapon, learn each challenge's target pattern, and replay the ones you miss until gold. Start early and do a few per session rather than leaving all 42 to the end.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: PlayStation official trophy description
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. Each location has its own race to win, so tour them one by one. Learn the course on a first attempt, then race it cleanly — a win at a location is what counts, and all 14 are needed.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: PlayStation official trophy description
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The word different matters: the same race won twice still counts once, so spread your wins across the race list. Work through the races in order and tick each new win off — 20 distinct wins unlocks the trophy.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: PlayStation official trophy description
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take on Cal in a fishing challenge and beat him. Fishing challenges are part of the activities set: head to a fishing spot, enter the challenge against Cal, and out-fish him. If you lose, try again — the challenge can be repeated until you win.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: PlayStation official trophy description
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Find an arcade machine and finish one full arcade game. Any arcade game counts — pick the one you find first and play it through to the end. This is one of the quickest activity trophies in the set.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: PlayStation official trophy description

trophies.guide: Play Andy's mission strand through to its final mission. Side characters hand out chains of missions, and the trophy unlocks when you finish the last one in Andy's chain. Check the map for Andy's marker whenever it appears and work the strand between story missions.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full sets of collectible cards. Cards are hidden around Leonida, and a set is complete when you hold every card in it. Collect as you explore — grab cards whenever you pass a location — and 3 finished sets unlock the silver. This is a long-tail collectible, so start picking cards up early.

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. WAiNK It is a phone-style check-in at places around Leonida, and each new location counts once toward the 100. Do it as you travel: whenever you arrive somewhere new, WAiNK It before moving on, and the total will climb without a dedicated grind.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge list. Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and more, and many complete themselves during normal play. Check the challenge list often, pick off the easy ones first, and keep chipping away — 50 done unlocks the trophy.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up to a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Get the heat up together — cause enough trouble to reach 4 stars — then break line of sight, hide, and wait for the wanted level to clear while your partner is still with you. Do it during the story while partner missions are available, since the moment may not come again.
trophies.missable_reason: Needs your partner beside you at 4 stars — a story moment that may not come again after the campaign.

trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level — meaning you must keep the heat on through all three robberies. Plan a route with 3 shops close together, hit them one after another, and keep moving between them. This needs a partner, so attempt it during the story while partner missions are available.
trophies.missable_reason: Needs your partner and 3 shops in a row — a story moment that may not come again after the campaign.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

The airport is the setting, and the departure is the point: get a plane moving and get out of VCIA on your own schedule. This is tied to the airport moment in the story, so try it when the story takes you there.
trophies.missable_reason: Tied to the VCIA moment — an unscheduled departure is a one-time chance while the story is at the airport.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and get away without ever being detected. Stealth is the whole requirement: plan the approach, avoid cameras and sightlines, take the goods quietly, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — reset and try again, and do it while the opportunity is available.
trophies.missable_reason: One clean, undetected robbery — being spotted ruins the attempt, so do it while the chance is open.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vaults are the big robberies: plan the hit, get inside, crack the vault, and get clear. Five successful vault jobs with escapes unlock the silver — pace them across the game rather than rushing all five at once.

trophies.guide: Share a partnership moment that lands with mass appeal. This is a story-partnership beat: play the partner missions, and when the moment with mass appeal comes, be in it. It is tied to the partnership, so take it while the story is still running its partner missions.
trophies.missable_reason: A partnership moment — it only happens while the story's partner missions are running.

trophies.guide: Make choices throughout the game — PlayStation tracks the count up to 500. Choices appear in story and side moments, so keep choosing whenever the game offers one instead of skipping past. The count grows across the whole playthrough, and the trophy unlocks when enough choices have been made.
trophies.missable_reason: Choices only come up while story moments offer them — keep choosing during the campaign, or the count stalls.

trophies.missable_reason: Needs a failed attempt followed at once by a success — the setup only exists in the moment.
